evals.prompt: What data do we have available to query in Omni? Give me an overview of our topics and what they cover.
evals.expected_output: Models listed, SHARED model identified, topics listed with descriptions. Each topic's base view and purpose summarized.
assertions: The agent calls omni models list and identifies the SHARED model (not the SCHEMA model) as the one to explore
The agent calls omni models list-topics with the SHARED model ID to get the topic list
The agent summarizes each topic by name and purpose — not just by listing raw API response fields

evals.prompt: I want to query revenue data. What fields and measures are available, and how do the relevant tables join together?
evals.expected_output: Most relevant topic inspected. Available revenue measures identified by name and aggregate type. Join relationships between views explained.
assertions: The agent calls omni models get-topic to inspect the relevant topic in detail — not just list topics
The agent identifies specific measure names (e.g., total_revenue) and their aggregate types from the topic response
The agent describes the join relationships from the topic's relationships[] — which views join to which, and on what condition

evals.prompt: I'm about to remove the 'sale_price' field from the model. What will break?
evals.expected_output: Field impact analysis run: branch created with field removed, content validator run against the branch, YAML searched for references. Full blast radius reported.
assertions: The agent creates a model branch and removes the field there — it does not touch the production model to assess impact
The agent runs omni models content-validator-get --branch-id to find broken dashboards and tiles
The agent also searches the model YAML for references to sale_price in other views, topics, or calculated fields
The agent reports both broken content (from the validator) and model references (from YAML search) before recommending any action

evals.prompt: Show me the AI context configured on the order_items topic — I want to understand what Blobby knows about this data.
evals.expected_output: Topic inspected with get-topic. ai_context, sample_queries, and ai_fields values returned and summarized clearly.
assertions: The agent calls omni models get-topic to retrieve the topic detail — it does not guess or hallucinate the ai_context content
The agent reports the actual ai_context text from the API response
If sample_queries are present in the topic, the agent includes them in the summary
